query:
SELECT DISTINCT k AS "k!" FROM (
            SELECT CASE $1
                WHEN 'prix-carburants' THEN fuel_ref
                WHEN 'laposte' THEN laposte_ref
                WHEN 'finess' THEN finess_ref
            END AS k
            FROM pois WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
        ) keys
        WHERE k IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY 1
